project_type: SailPoint ISC full-page UI plugin: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite SPA that runs inside the ISC App Shell iframe. All data flows through the generated sailpoint-api-client, authenticated via the @sailpoint/ui-plugin-sdk handshake.
build_system: Vite 8 + tsc. `npm run build` runs `tsc -b && vite build`. ESLint 10 flat config via `npm run lint`.
test_framework: Vitest 3 + @testing-library/react + @testing-library/user-event + jsdom. Test files are co-located as *.test.ts(x). Setup file: src/test/setup.ts.
test_command: npm test   (= vitest run; use `npx vitest run <path>` to scope to a module)
verification_instructions: Baseline is GREEN: `npm test` = 67 tests pass. After changes: (1) `npx vitest run <changed-module-dir>` while iterating, (2) `npm test` for the whole suite, (3) `npm run lint` clean, (4) `npm run build` succeeds (type-check + bundle). There is NO git repository in this workspace, so do NOT run git commands and do NOT commit — rely on npm test/build as the proof each feature works.
environment_constraints: NO git repo in the worktree (git rev-parse fails) — skip all commit/push steps from generic instructions; verification is npm test/build only. node_modules is already installed. The sailpoint-api-client sub-path modules are the source of API truth (dist/*.d.ts); do NOT invent endpoints. Do NOT modify sp-ui-plugin.json apiScopes, vite.config.ts, or the handshake logic in sdkClient.ts (only add a SearchApi to PluginRuntime).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering exists. Follow README.md conventions: keep SailPoint jargon out of user-facing strings (use plain language like 'Reassign', not 'delegate'); keep the data layer (src/sailpoint) mapping raw DTOs into decoupled view-model types (src/sailpoint/types.ts) and returning FriendlyError; keep domain logic pure in src/domain. Match the existing high comment density that explains WHY.
key_patterns: Decision flow: ReviewQueue -> ReviewItemCard button -> onDecide(itemId, choice) -> CertApp.CampaignRoute.handleDecide -> useDecisions.open(item, choice) -> DecisionDialog -> useDecisions.confirm(comment) -> certifications.decide(...) with OPTIMISTIC update (review.applyDecision) + rollback (review.revertDecision) on FriendlyError. DecisionChoice is the union 'allow' | 'remove' used as a Record key in language.ts (DECISION_LABEL, DECISION_MEANING, CANNED_COMMENTS) and branched on in DecisionDialog/ReviewItemCard — adding 'reassign' forces all those sites to update (compiler finds them). API wrappers (certifications.ts) use the request-OBJECT call style, e.g. api.makeIdentityDecisionV1({ id, reviewDecision }); the reassign method is api.reassignIdentityCertificationsV1({ id, reviewReassign }) returning AxiosPromise<IdentityCertificationDto> (.data is the DTO). API classes are built from one Configuration in sdkClient.ts initPlugin and stored on PluginRuntime. Enum/type values are imported from the SUBPATH 'sailpoint-api-client/certifications/api' (CertificationDecision is imported as a value there today); SearchApi/Index come from 'sailpoint-api-client/search/api' and SearchApi is also re-exported from the package root.

api_ground_truth.reassign: import { ReassignReferenceTypeEnum } from 'sailpoint-api-client/certifications/api' (VALUE import, like CertificationDecision). Build body: { reassign: [{ id: itemId, type: ReassignReferenceTypeEnum.Item }], reassignTo: reassignToId, reason: comment }. Call: api.reassignIdentityCertificationsV1({ id: certificationId, reviewReassign }). Returns AxiosPromise<IdentityCertificationDto>; map res.data via toCampaignVM. ReassignReferenceTypeEnum = { TargetSummary:'TARGET_SUMMARY', Item:'ITEM', IdentitySummary:'IDENTITY_SUMMARY' }.
api_ground_truth.search: import { Index, SearchApi } from 'sailpoint-api-client/search/api' (SearchApi also at package root). Call: api.searchPostV1({ search: { indices: [Index.Identities], query: { query: nameQuery }, sort: ['name'] }, limit: 25, count: false }). Response .data is Array<object> (untyped rows) — read id/displayName/name/email/emailAddress defensively (see org-graph map-identity.ts). Index.Identities === 'identities'.
